author: Unept
description_zh:
一款“说公平其实不太公平”的2D平台跳跃游戏。你扮演一个小家伙，目标是抵达每关尽头的门——但地面会突然裂开、尖刺会凭空出现、传送门会把你送到致命的位置[reference:5]。

近200个短小关卡，每5关围绕一个主题（尖刺、金币、移动平台等）。操作简单，但陷阱会不断变化：移动的洞、阴险的墙、塌陷的地板、隐形陷阱，还有反转重力和传送等新机制[reference:7]。适合喜欢硬核平台跳跃、搞笑失败和“ rage game ”的玩家[reference:8]。
description_en:
A 2D platformer with a mean twist. Your goal is simple: reach the door at the end of each level — but the floor opens up beneath you, spikes appear out of nowhere, and teleporters warp you to fatal spots[reference:9].

Nearly 200 short, unpredictable levels, grouped in fives around a theme (spikes, coins, moving platforms, etc.). Controls are simple, but the traps keep changing: moving holes, treacherous walls, collapsing floors, invisible traps, plus reverse gravity, teleports, and more[reference:11]. Built for fans of hard platformers, funny fails, and rage games[reference:12].
